space: three.js pet model space = the accessory_root group (body child, offset -0.18125). +Y up, pet faces +Z. Equivalent to the GLB scene space of models/<pet>.glb at rest.
apply: obj.position.fromArray(position); obj.rotation.set(...rotation) (radians, XYZ); obj.scale.setScalar(scale); add obj to anchors.root (identity), NOT to the app's per-pet-offset anchors.

attachPoints.hat: GLB origin = centre of the flat head top (0, 1.431, 0)
attachPoints.face: GLB origin = eye line on the lens/face plane, centred between the eyes
attachPoints.neck: GLB origin = cube centre line at neck height
attachPoints.body: GLB origin = centre of the cube underside (0, 0.181, 0)
attachPoints.back: GLB origin = centre of the back face (0, 0.806, -0.625)

hatSource: Hat transforms reproduce buildOutfit() hat anchor maths from js/accessories.js PET_FIT (hat, hatZ, hatScale, hatTilt) unchanged, except the lion (hatAdjust).

lion.why: lifted onto the mane: +dy on Y, front tipped up by tilt (rad), scaled

top_hat.note: Kenney snowman-hat, unchanged: no GLB here; keep the app's topHat() builder and apply this transform to the hat anchor.

scarf.note: Origin sits under the chin. Scale clears the sweater collar so the wrap layers over it.

note: Sweater GLBs are not shipped. Dayli keeps the striped sweater builder.
